activity.notes: The Norwegian Council elected Frederick I king in 1524, one year after his Danish accession. He remained King of Norway until his death in 1533. ATLAS therefore separates the Norwegian 1524-1533 kingship from Denmark and from his Schleswig-Holstein rule.

sources.title: Frederik 1. – konge 1524–1533 — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: Store norske leksikon states that Frederick I was King of Denmark in 1523-1533 and King of Norway in 1524-1533, after the Norwegian Council elected him in 1524.
